title: Ctrl+S saves nothing outside the script editor — CSV grid has dirty tracking but no save shortcut
why: The recommendation is already implemented. The Ctrl+S case in ProcessCmdKey (Form1.cs:14454-14461) breaks — it does not return true — so outside the script editor the keystroke falls to base.ProcessCmdKey, which dispatches the File menu shortcut: saveToolStripMenuItem has ShortcutKeys = Ctrl+S (Form1.Designer.cs:1511) and its handler (Form1.cs:5697-5700) calls SaveCurrentCsv(promptIfNoPath: true), which commits any in-progress grid cell edit, falls through to Save-As when no path exists, and shows a "Saved: <file>" status-bar confirmation (Form1.cs:9300). Ctrl+Shift+S → SaveCsvAs is also already bound (Form1.Designer.cs:1519). The only real behavior is the intentional override that Ctrl+S saves the preset instead when the script editor is focused; "silently swallowed and does nothing" with grid focus is factually wrong.
